mapper.select: SELECT c.USER_ID as userId, c.SALE_ITEM_ID as saleItemId, c.QUANTITY as quantity, s.TITLE as productTitle, s.PRICE as price, s.QTY as stock, s.JUDGE_KIND_NAME as productType, s.CUT_NAME as cutType, s.GRADE as grade, (c.QUANTITY * s.PRICE) as totalPrice FROM CART c INNER JOIN SALES s ON c.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{buyerId} ORDER BY c.SALE_ITEM_ID

SELECT c.USER_ID as userId, c.SALE_ITEM_ID as saleItemId, c.QUANTITY as quantity, s.TITLE as productTitle, s.PRICE as price, s.QTY as stock, s.JUDGE_KIND_NAME as productType, s.CUT_NAME as cutType, s.GRADE as grade, (c.QUANTITY * s.PRICE) as totalPrice FROM CART c INNER JOIN SALES s ON c.SALE_ITEM_ID = s.SALE_ITEM_ID WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} AND c.SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CART (USER_ID, SALE_ITEM_ID, QUANTITY) VALUES (#{userId}, #{saleItemId}, #{quantity})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM CART WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND SALE_ITEM_ID = #{saleItemId}
